content.short: Electron zkBridge builds cross-chain connectors using zero-knowledge proofs.
content.description: Bridges today are not decentralized. They operate through multi-sigs and centralized state proofs. Electron Labs aims to enable blockchains to talk to each other in a permissionless manner using zero-knowledge proofs. Electron zkBridge can transfer assets between Near and Ethereum, and the protocol is permissionless, decentralized, and secured by zkSNARKs.
content.meta: Electron zkBridge enables cross-chain asset transfers with zero-knowledge proofs. Discover Electron zkBridge and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
